phase_b.note: sweep run over 45 sites and 38 real agenda paths: zero schema.org Event blocks outside the two aggregators. The sweep did find the platform they share, which is B3.

phase_b.hint: check whether stager.nl ticketing exposes a per-venue JSON endpoint; many NL podia run on it, so one adapter could cover a dozen
phase_b.note: stager.co shops publish the whole programme as one clean JSON-LD block, and https://<slug>.stager.co/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' with only Googlebot and facebookexternalhit exempt. Tried: the shop page (disallowed), the venue's own /wp-json/wp/v2/<event type> (the only date is the post's publish date, ACF is empty over REST), and an iCal sweep (no venue serves one). The venues' own pages are what got scraped instead, one by one.
